Overview

About CGTMSE

CGTMSE provides a credit guarantee to banks and NBFCs so they can lend to micro and small enterprises without asking for collateral security or a third-party guarantee. It is one of the most widely used routes for first-generation entrepreneurs who don't have property to mortgage.

The guarantee covers term loans and working capital for both new and existing units in manufacturing, services and retail trade. The guarantee limit was enhanced from ₹5 Crore to ₹10 Crore in 2025.

Key benefits

  • No collateral or third-party guarantee required
  • Covers term loans, working capital and composite loans
  • Guarantee cover of 75% to 90% depending on borrower category
  • Higher cover for women entrepreneurs and micro units
  • Available through most public, private and small finance banks
  • Can be combined with subsidy schemes such as PMEGP

Who is eligible

  • Udyam-registered micro or small enterprise
  • New or existing unit in manufacturing, services or retail trade
  • Loan sanctioned by a CGTMSE member lending institution
  • Viable project with a sound repayment plan
  • Account not in default with any lender

Documents required

  • Udyam registration certificate
  • KYC of promoters (PAN, Aadhaar)
  • Detailed project report
  • Last 2 to 3 years' financials and ITR (existing units)
  • 12 months' bank statements
  • GST registration and business address proof
